market_name: Will 7 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market's implied 7-cut probability move persists or is a thin-liquidity blip; watch 2y/10y yields and fed funds futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check against any Fed speaker headlines, labor/inflation data surprises, or risk-off catalysts that could justify aggressive easing bets.
time_plan.2h: Assess TLT price action vs. move in front-end futures; if front end leads and long end lags, curve is bull-steepening as expected.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether the dovish repricing is broad (equities, gold, dollar all consistent) or idiosyncratic to the Polymarket contract.
time_plan.12h: Confirm whether TLT held any gains into the window close; log whether the prediction-market move led or lagged the Treasury move.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 7 cuts (175bps of easing) in 2026 signals a dramatic dovish repricing — likely tied to recession or an emergency-easing scenario. Aggressive expected Fed easing pulls the entire front-to-belly of the curve lower in yield, and long-duration Treasuries rally as terminal-rate and growth expectations collapse. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for that duration bid.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the prediction-market spike is real and check DXY/EURUSD reaction alongside front-end rate futures.
time_plan.1h: Determine if the dovish narrative is US-specific (dollar-negative) or global risk-off (dollar could rally on haven flows).
time_plan.2h: Watch whether other central-bank pricing shifts too; relative dovishness, not absolute, drives FX.
time_plan.6h: Reassess UUP vs. gold and Treasuries for internal consistency of the easing thesis.
time_plan.12h: Log net UUP move and whether the FX proxy behaved as a rate-differential trade or a haven trade.

predictions.reasoning: An abrupt jump in odds of seven 2026 cuts implies a widening negative US rate differential vs. other central banks, which typically weakens the dollar. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. Conviction is lower than the Treasury leg because a recession-driven dovish scenario can also trigger safe-haven dollar demand, muddying the FX signal.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme dovish tail (7 cuts = ~175bps of easing in 2026)
Aggressive Fed easing historically co-moves with lower Treasury yields, weaker USD, and firmer gold
A jump in this contract's probability would signal a major shift in easing expectations or recession odds
uncertainty_notes: The market is a noisy, thin sensor; a probability move could be liquidity-driven not information-driven
7 cuts is a low-base-rate tail; even a large relative probability shift may be a small absolute repricing that barely moves rates
Recession-driven easing can make the dollar rally (haven) rather than fall, inverting the FX leg
12h magnitudes here are far below the 700bps tradable threshold — these are not tradable signals

llm_justification.summary: This contract prices an extreme dovish 2026 Fed path. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal aggressive-easing/recession expectations, mapping to a duration rally (TLT up) and a weaker dollar (UUP down), with gold as a secondary beneficiary. Both mappings are directionally plausible but low-confidence, and expected 12h magnitudes fall well below the tradable threshold — treat as research, not a signal.
key_assumptions: A prediction-market move reflects genuine shift in Fed-path expectations, not noise
Rate-cut expectations transmit to Treasury yields and FX via standard rate-differential channels
The dovish scenario is US-specific enough to weaken the dollar rather than trigger haven demand
failure_modes: Move was already public — Fed pricing largely set by futures/data, so Polymarket adds little new information
Reversal: thin prediction-market liquidity produces a spike that mean-reverts within hours
Weak/ambiguous proxy: recession-driven easing flips USD to a haven bid, breaking the UUP-down thesis
Magnitude far below 700bps threshold — no tradable edge even if direction is right
Category tag 'military_conflict' appears mislabeled; if a real conflict shock drives easing bets, haven dynamics dominate and dollar/gold could both rise
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
